objective_status: active; not all workloads are as fast as the tuned open-source baseline

conditions.accuracy: case tolerance unchanged; default exact certificate; independent tools/eval for every full comparison

cautions: gpu01 runs showed interference from another user process and are retained only as preliminary evidence.
The first short kernel batches include frequency warmup; the longer batches and within-process OpenBLAS controls are the usable microbenchmarks.
Single-run broad screening is correctness/regression screening, not a stable speedup claim.
The original-residual single-vector candidate was withdrawn after validation showed probe costs could exceed saved solve work.

final-ab, final-broad and recheck-ab used the combined candidate before withdrawal. Their default block paths do not use the withdrawn single-vector change; retained-ab tests the final rebuilt executable directly.
The SLEPc measurements compare against this repository's tuned case profile, not all possible open-source solvers.
No new million-unknown head-to-head comparison was made in this round.
retained_changes: Keep the A vector in a register across the two-column TN FMAs.
Use an eight-row AVX-512 TN tile for two columns with K <= 256; keep four rows for longer columns.
Fuse norm-estimation vector updates and deterministic reductions, and parallelize vector normalization.

build/release/bench_asmkern_kernels peak --n 2048 --reps 5 > /tmp/os2026-p11/kernel-final-warmup.md; for label in before final final before; do case "$label" in before) bin=/tmp/os2026-p11/kernels-before;; final) bin=build/release/bench_asmkern_kernels;; esac; "$bin" shapes --shapes "gemm:TN:32:2:1024:100000;gemm:TN:32:4:1024:100000;gemm:TN:16:2:32:48;gemm:TN:32:2:128:100000" --routes off,narrow --reps 201 --pool-mb 32 --inpar 1 >> /tmp/os2026-p11/kernel-final-$label.md; done
